title: Print Window Gray Color
description: All print windows should use normal gray color same as paragraph headings instead of different tier colors (primary/secondary/tertiary).
summary: Print windows now use the same muted gray chrome as paragraph headings instead of tier colors (primary/secondary/tertiary). Window title bars render via `\semio@window@header@muted` using `\semio@heading@cap@muted`, and tier `tcolorbox` styles no longer override `colframe` with brand colors.
